body: Build hunk refinement after native execution: add `Test / fork := true` and `Test / envVars += "ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY" -> "1"` to both embedOnnx and embedBench settings. ONNX Runtime 1.29 initializes native telemetry before Java can call setTelemetry(false) and otherwise creates `:memory:.ses`; the adapter now fails startup before loading native code unless ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 was present when the JVM started. Measured court: -DORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 still created the file; process env ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 did not. The remaining module/dependency hunk is unchanged.
